# Codesphere

> Status: 6 Mei 2026. Fokus: evaluasi akun tes, gulungake ekstensi King, lan jalanake beban kerja panggilan video kanthi elastis.

## Daftar Isi

- [Profil operasi](#operating-profile)
- [Opsi ekspansi](#expansion-options)
- [King Peluncuran Ekstensi](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Autoscaling kanggo Telpon Video](#autoscaling-for-video-calls)
- [Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [Email lan DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [TCTerms kaputusan](#decision-points)
- [Sumber](#sources)

## Profil operasi

Codesphere migunani yen kita pengin pratinjau sing bisa direproduksi lan nyoba lingkungan kanthi cepet tanpa nggunakake Kubernetes awake dhewe. Kanggo produksi, mode ruang kerja kudu **Tansah Aktif**. Siyaga ora cocok kanggo target nelpon-gabung amarga ruang kerja bisa diwiwiti kanthi cepet, nanging app isih kudu bali kanthi resik liwat tahapan.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  User[Browser / Mobile] --> Domain[app.kingrt.com]
  Domain --> Frontend[Codesphere Frontend Service]
  Frontend --> Api[API Service]
  Frontend --> Ws[WebSocket Service]
  Ws --> Sfu[SFU / Call Runtime]
  Api --> Store[(DB / Object Store)]
  Sfu --> Store
  Api --> OTel[OTel Collector]
  Ws --> OTel
  Sfu --> OTel
```

## Opsi ekspansi

| Pilihan | Gunakake kasus | Potensi autoscaling | resiko |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Tansah-On Workspace | Akun test, demo, conto pementasan cilik | Vertikal liwat rencana sumber daya; skala horisontal mung sebagéyan migunani | Runtime tunggal, ora ana distribusi SFU nyata |
| Replika | Layanan HTTP/API tanpa negara | Replika bisa ditambah kanthi horisontal liwat UI/API | Sistem file sing dienggo bareng, ora ana tulisan sing saingan |
| Landscapes | Multiple services in one workspace: Frontend, API, WS, SFU, worker | Layanan bisa ukuran dhewe | Komunikasi layanan kudu nggunakake jeneng layanan internal |
| Public API + King Orchestrator | Rilis otomatis lan operasi skala | Fondasi kanggo skala-out sing dikontrol King | Verifikasi fitur API konkret ing akun test |
| Layanan Stateful njaba | DB, toko obyek, antrian, surat | Decouples replika saka sistem file ruang kerja | Tetep jaringan, rahasia, lan serep dipisahake |

## King Peluncuran Ekstensi

1. Sambungake repositori menyang ruang kerja Codesphere.
2. Setel ruang kerja dadi **Tansah Aktif** yen lingkungan kudu nampa lalu lintas telpon.
3. Njaga env vars saben ruang kerja: `KING_ENV`, `KING_BASE_URL`, `KING_API_URL`, `KING_WS_URL`, `KING_SFU_URL`, `KING_OBJECT_STORE_*`, `SMTP_*`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.
4. Njaga `ci.yml` kanthi tahap nyiapake, nguji, lan mbukak. Tahap run kudu miwiti saben layanan tanpa ambigu lan diwiwiti maneh kanthi otomatis sawise kacilakan.
5. Pisah lanskap: nemtokake frontend, API, WebSocket, SFU, lan buruh latar mburi minangka layanan sing kapisah.
6. Gunakake Codesphere-jeneng layanan pribadi kanggo komunikasi internal, dudu URL umum.
7. Aja nulis log menyang file sing dienggo bareng. Yen log file perlu, pamisah saben replika nganggo `CS_REPLICA`.

```yaml
prepare:
  steps:
    - name: install frontend
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm ci && npm run build
    - name: backend sanity
      command: ./demo/video-chat/backend-king-php/tests/smoke.sh
test:
  steps:
    - name: frontend contracts
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm run test:contract:client-diagnostics
run:
  steps:
    - name: king api
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-api.sh
    - name: king ws
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-ws.sh
    - name: king sfu
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-sfu.sh
```

## Autoscaling kanggo Telpon Video

- **Gabung target:** Telpon lobi lan sinyal kudu anget. Always-On wajib kanggo target gabung sub-detik.
- **Stateless API:** Codesphere replika pas yen sesi wis divalidasi tengah lan file lokal ora digunakake minangka negara.
- **WebSocket:** Rute lengket utawa toko sesi/presensi tengah dibutuhake. Tanpa iku, owah-owahan replika nyebarake negara telpon kanthi ora bener.
- **SFU:** Aja niru kanthi wuta. Kamar kudu ditugasake menyang SFU shard; a King orkestra kudu ngontrol kamar-kanggo-SFU nuntun lan draining.
- ** Telpon app / buruh: ** Kandidat sing luwih apik kanggo replika horisontal nalika proyek idempoten lan antrian / ngunci urip ing njaba ruang kerja.
- **Sistem berkas sing dienggo bareng:** Codesphere replika bareng `/home/user/app`. Status runtime, jitter buffer, upload, lan log ora ana ing kana.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant API as API Replica
  participant ORC as King Orchestrator
  participant SFU as SFU Shard
  participant O as Object Store
  B->>API: Join Call
  API->>ORC: allocate room / capabilities
  ORC->>SFU: reserve room
  SFU-->>ORC: room endpoint
  ORC-->>API: signed routing token
  API-->>B: ws/sfu endpoint
  B->>SFU: publish media
  SFU->>O: diagnostics / snapshots only
```

## Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry

- Kanggo Codesphere, kirim OTLP langsung menyang kolektor eksternal dhisik.
- Layanan aplikasi disetel `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, lan `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`.
- Gunakake jeneng layanan sing kapisah saben layanan: `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, `king-callapp-worker`.
- Sawise lanskap stabil, OTel Kolektor bisa mbukak minangka layanan internal lan ngekspor menyang Grafana/Tempo/Loki/Prometheus Remote Write.

## Email lan DNS

- Aja mbukak SMTP lokal. Codesphere ruang kerja ngirim mung liwat SMTP eksternal utawa panyedhiya surat transaksional.
- Simpen rahasia ing env vars: `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`, `MAIL_FROM`, `MAIL_REPLY_TO`.
- Tetep DNS kanggo domain produksi sing dipérang ing app/API/WS/SFU/CDN.
- Verifikasi SPF, DKIM, lan DMARC ing domain sing ngirim utawa pesenan lan email timbal bakal mlebu spam.

## TCTerms kaputusan

- Apa akun tes bisa nggunakake lanskap?
- Apa ana akses API kanggo replika/rencana sumber daya kanggo skala otomatis?
- Kepiye carane domain khusus lan rute dalan diaktifake ing akun kasebut?
- Apa watesan sing ditrapake kanggo CPU, RAM, panyimpenan, replika, lan sambungan WebSocket mbukak?
- Apa port SFU lan sambungan WebSocket dawa bisa mlaku kanthi stabil?

# Hetzner

## Daftar Isi

- [Profil operasi](#operating-profile)
- [Opsi ekspansi](#expansion-options)
- [King Peluncuran Ekstensi](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Autoscaling model](#autoscaling-model)
- [Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [Email lan DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Sumber](#sources)

## Profil operasi

Hetzner minangka jalur Infrastruktur-minangka-Layanan langsung. Kita entuk server API-driven, load balancer, jaringan, firewall, IP ngambang, lan volume. Sing nggawe Hetzner pilihan paling apik kanggo King nalika kita pengin ngontrol autoscaling dhewe.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Internet --> LB[Hetzner Load Balancer]
  LB --> FE[Frontend/API Pool]
  LB --> WS[WebSocket Pool]
  LB --> SFU[SFU Pool]
  FE --> DB[(Postgres / Redis)]
  WS --> Redis[(Presence / Session Store)]
  SFU --> Obj[(Object Store)]
  ORC[King Orchestrator] --> HCLOUD[Hetzner Cloud API]
  HCLOUD --> FE
  HCLOUD --> WS
  HCLOUD --> SFU
```

## Opsi ekspansi

| Pilihan | Gunakake kasus | Autoscaling | Rekomendasi |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Server awan tunggal + Docker Tulis | Pilot cepet | Manual / basis API | Dev / pementasan mung |
| 2-3 server + Hetzner Load Balancer | HA kanggo frontend/API/WS | King orkestra timbangan grup server liwat API | Langkah penengah sing apik |
| k3s/Talos/Kubernetes ing Hetzner | Pod HPA, KEDA, skala simpul | Kuwat, nanging kita operate | Bentuk target kanggo skala panggilan video |
| Server ROOT khusus + maya LB | Kinerja tetep kanggo SFU | Manual utawa King orkestra | Cocog kanggo kapasitas SFU sing bisa diprediksi |
| Hibrida: Codesphere pratinjau, Hetzner prod | Pratinjau cepet + produksi sing dikontrol | Pratinjau kapisah, prod API-driven | Pragmatik |

## King Peluncuran Ekstensi

1. Gawe gambar dhasar kanggo `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, lan `king-worker`.
2. Server pranata kanthi label: `role=api`, `role=ws`, `role=sfu`, `env=prod`.
3. Gunakake jaringan pribadi kanggo API/WS/SFU/DB; mung load balancers sing umum.
4. Firewall: mung 80/443 umum, SSH mung saka admin IP/VPN, port internal mung ing jaringan pribadi.
5. Gulungake ekstensi King minangka layanan sistem utawa panyebaran Kubernetes.
6. Ndhaptar SFU pecahan kanthi metrik kapasitas: CPU, RAM, kamar aktif, nerbitake FPS, tingkat pemulihan.
7. Tambah draining: mungkasi nemtokake kamar anyar, supaya telpon ana rampung, banjur copot simpul.

## Autoscaling model

- **Tingkat pod:** Kubernetes HPA kanggo API/WS/pegawe, KEDA kanggo buruh antrian utawa acara.
- **Tingkat simpul:** Cluster Autoscaler utawa King orkestra liwat Hetzner Cloud API.
- **SFU level:** sinyal khusus luwih penting tinimbang CPU: penerbit aktif, stream outbound, tekanan encoder, rute pemulihan, RTT, lan paket ilang.
- **Aplikasi Telpon:** Skala minangka blumbang buruh; proyek kudu idempoten.
- **Panyimpenan obyek:** unggahan, avatar, gambar latar mburi, lan artefak kudu ora manggon ing disk lokal.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> WarmPool
  WarmPool --> ScaleOut: rooms > threshold or recovery pressure
  ScaleOut --> RegisterNode: hcloud create server
  RegisterNode --> AcceptRooms: health + otel ready
  AcceptRooms --> Drain: low demand or maintenance
  Drain --> DeleteNode: active rooms = 0
  DeleteNode --> WarmPool
```

## Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry

- Kubernetes: OTel Kolektor minangka DaemonSet kanggo log simpul/pod lan minangka panyebaran kanggo metrik kluster.
- VM/Compose: OTel Kolektor saben simpul minangka layanan utawa wadhah sistemd.
- Metrik sing dibutuhake: `call.join.latency`, `sfu.publisher.count`, `sfu.recovery.routes`, `ws.session.reconnects`, `object_store.upload.duration`, `mail.send.duration`.
- Target ekspor: eksternal OTLP kolektor pisanan; mengko tumpukan observability kita dhewe.

## Email lan DNS

- Surat transaksi liwat SMTP eksternal utawa layanan surat khusus.
- Setel SPF, DKIM, lan DMARC ing domain sing ngirim.
- Pisah DNS kanthi resik: `app`, `api`, `ws`, `sfu`, `cdn`, `otel`.
- Aja mbukak port acak kanggo SFU; rute liwat ditetepake TLS/WebSocket endpoints.

- [Hetzner Load Balancers](https://docs.hetzner.com/networking/load-balancers/overview/)
- [Hetzner Awan API: Nggunakake API](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/)
- [Hetzner Manajer Pengontrol Awan](https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-cloud-controller-manager)
- [Kubernetes Autoscaling](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/)

## Profil operasi

Adhedhasar dokumentasi umum saiki, Intares katon kaya hosting sing dikelola/mitra server sing dikelola kanthi server terisolasi, serep, manajemen, lan persiyapan Docker/private-cloud opsional. Sing apik kanggo infrastruktur khusus sing dioperasikake. Model API autoscaling layanan mandiri kaya Hetzner utawa lapisan replika PaaS kaya Codesphere ora didokumentasikake kanthi umum kanggo diandelake.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  King[King Platform Team] --> Runbook[Runbook + Release Bundle]
  Runbook --> Intares[Intares Managed Ops]
  Intares --> Nodes[Managed Server / Private Cloud]
  Nodes --> Apps[King API / WS / SFU / Worker]
  Apps --> Observability[OTel + Alerts]
  Observability --> King
```

## Opsi ekspansi

| Pilihan | Gunakake kasus | Autoscaling | resiko |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ngatur server siji | Produksi cilik diwiwiti | Vertikal / manual | Ora ana elastis panggilan spike penanganan |
| Pasangan HA ngatur | API/situs web kanthi failover | Manual dening runbook | SFU nuntun kudu dijlentrehake |
| Docker ing server sing dikelola | Reproducible King layanan | Skrip/API mung yen diaktifake | Njlentrehake wates operator |
| Layanan awan pribadi | Kluster khusus pelanggan | Bisa, nanging kontrak / operasional | Ora ana asumsi tanpa tawaran |
| Intares + Hetzner/Codesphere hibrida | Ngatur DB / keamanan + karyawan app elastis ing papan liya | Eksternal King orkestra | Dokumen jaringan / GDPR wates kanthi resik |

## King Peluncuran Ekstensi

1. Intares nampa bundel rilis versi utawa gambar wadhah saka registri kita.
2. Kita nyedhiyakake unit systemd utawa Compose/Kubernetes manifests kanggo API, WS, SFU, lan buruh.
3. Rahasia ora dikirim ing bundel; lagi disetel ing Intares rahasia / persiyapan server.
4. Pemeriksa kesehatan kudu bisa digayuh kanthi kapisah dening Intares ngawasi lan King orkestra.
5. Gawe serep: tetep DB serep konsisten, versi nyimpen obyek, lan ora gawe serep buffer runtime lokal.
6. Rollback: simpen gambar lawas / bundel lan evaluasi migrasi database kanthi strategi mudhun sadurunge.

## Autoscaling kasunyatan

- Tanpa akses API layanan mandiri sing didokumentasikan, kita ora kudu ngrancang Intares minangka target skala otomatis.
- Lonjakan panggilan video mbutuhake paling ora konsep blumbang panas utawa wektu reaksi operator sing dijamin.
- SFU skala kudu direncanakake minangka blumbang kapasitas: shards tetep ditambah provisioning manual utawa otomatis kontrak.
- Yen Intares nyedhiyakake Kubernetes/awan pribadi, Kubernetes aturan ditrapake: HPA/KEDA kanggo beban kerja, skala simpul mung karo integrasi panyedhiya.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant K as King Orchestrator
  participant M as Monitoring
  participant I as Intares Ops
  participant N as Managed Node
  M->>K: capacity pressure
  K->>I: scale request / ticket / API if available
  I->>N: provision or resize
  N-->>K: health ready
  K->>N: assign new rooms
```

## Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry

- OTel Kolektor minangka layanan utawa wadhah sistem ing saben host.
- Intares ngawasi bisa mlaku bebarengan, nanging King mbutuhake data OTLP dhewe kanggo skala khusus telpon.
- Tandha loro-lorone: operator kanggo host/jaringan/disk, King tim kanggo metrik telpon lan kesalahan app.

## Email lan DNS

- Yen Intares ngoperasikake surat: njlentrehake SPF/DKIM/DMARC lan penanganan bouncing kanthi tulisan.
- Yen eksternal SMTP digunakake: simpen kredensial minangka rahasia sing dikelola lan dokumen domain sing dikirim ing sisih kita.
- Temtokake zona DNS lan kepemilikan sertifikat sadurunge diluncurake.

## Pitakonan kanggo Intares

- Apa ana API kanggo operasi server/firewall/LB/DNS/skala?
- Apa Docker Tulis, Kubernetes, utawa orkestrasi awan pribadi ditawakake?
- Kepiye cara panyebaran lan rollbacks?
- Apa SLA ditrapake kanggo scaling short-notice?
- Apa kita bisa mbukak OTel Kolektor, Prometheus eksportir, lan mriksa kesehatan kita dhewe?
- Kepiye cara WebSocket lan SFU sambungan sing tahan suwe ditangani ing load balancer?

## Profil operasi

mittwald nawakake hosting wadah ing mStudio kanthi UI, CLI, API, lan Terraform. Wadah bisa diwiwiti saka registri, disebarake minangka tumpukan, dikonfigurasi karo env vars, volume, lan port, lan kapapar liwat domain/ingress. Sing kuwat kanggo situs web, API, buruh, lan layanan sing luwih cilik. Kanggo target skala otomatis SFU sing ketat, kita isih kudu nyoba apa sumber daya lan instan bisa dikontrol kanthi otomatis.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Registry[Image Registry] --> MW[mStudio / CLI / Terraform]
  MW --> Stack[Container Stack]
  Stack --> Frontend[Frontend Container]
  Stack --> Api[API Container]
  Stack --> Worker[Worker Container]
  Stack --> Collector[OTel Collector Container]
  Domain[Domain / Ingress] --> Frontend
  Frontend --> Api
  Api --> Worker
```

## Opsi ekspansi

| Pilihan | Gunakake kasus | Autoscaling | Rekomendasi |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mStudio Wadhah | Persiyapan manual, tes cepet | Manual | Titik mlebu sing apik |
| `mw container run` | Penyebaran skrip | Scriptable | Kanggo runbooks |
| `mw stack deploy` | Tumpukan sing kompatibel karo Compose | Stack-based | Apik kanggo API / buruh |
| Terraform Panyedhiya | Infrastruktur versi | Plannable, reviewable | Preferred kanggo lingkungan reproducible |
| API Nganyari Gambar | Rolling release/mutable tag narik | Bisa otomatis | Migunani kanggo CI/CD |

## King Peluncuran Ekstensi

1. Gawe gambar wadhah kanggo layanan King banjur push menyang GitHub/GitLab/DockerHub/registri pribadi.
2. Nemtokake tumpukan wadhah mittwald: API, WS, buruh, kolektor opsional.
3. Gunakake ingress umum mung kanggo frontend/API/WS; nyambungake layanan internal liwat jeneng DNS internal.
4. Gunakake volume mung kanggo data sing terus-terusan. Buffer wektu lan buffer jitter tetep ing RAM.
5. Pasang tag gambar sing ora bisa diganti: `king-api:1.0.8`, `king-ws:1.0.8`, `king-worker:1.0.8`.
6. Gulungake rilis kanthi variabel `mw container update --image...` utawa Terraform `image_tag`.

```bash
mw container run \
  --name king-api \
  --env KING_ENV=production \
  --env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.example.com \
  -p 8080:8080/tcp \
  registry.example.com/king-api:1.0.8
```

## Assessment autoscaling

- API lan buruh bisa wadhah kanthi apik.
- Kanggo video SFU, nyoba sambungan sing tahan suwe, CPU reservasi, prilaku port/ingress, lan kontrol instan horisontal.
- Tanpa fitur penskala otomatis asli sing didokumentasikan, rencanakake mittwald minangka target wadah sing dikelola kanthi skala kontrol liwat API/Terraform, dudu minangka penskala otomatis SFU kanthi otomatis.
- Aplikasi telpon bisa mbukak ing pirang-pirang wadhah pekerja yen antrian / kunci manggon ing njaba platform wadhah.

## Ngawasi nganggo OpenTelemetry

- Ekspor OTel langsung saka saben wadhah menyang kolektor eksternal.
- Utawa, mbukak kolektor minangka wadhah dhewe ing tumpukan yen jangkauan internal stabil.
- Tansah log katon ing mStudio, nanging aja digunakake minangka siji-sijine sumber diagnostik.

## Email lan DNS

- Kirimi layang liwat panyedhiya SMTP/transaksional eksternal utawa mittwald surat mung sawise mriksa pangiriman.
- Konfigurasi SPF/DKIM/DMARC kanggo domain sing ngirim.
- Peta domain umum ing mStudio menyang wadhah / mlebu: `app`, `api`, `ws`, opsional `cdn`.
